kpis.name: Viral Velocity Score
kpis.description: Predicts a video's viral probability using a power-law model fitted separately for each niche x account-size group. Weights derived from 60 regression fits across Short and Medium formats.
kpis.formula: VVS = Pr^a * A^b * R^g (power-law, group-fitted weights). a=prompt rate, b=avg views, g=retention. Normalized to 0-100.

prompt_rate.description: Percentage of viewers prompted to share/engage (%)

retention_rate.description: Percentage of viewers who watch past key retention point (%)

output.description: Viral velocity score 0-100. >=70 high, 40-69 moderate, <40 low

interpretation.low: VVS < 40: Weak signal. Lift Prompt Rate or Retention.

kpis.note: Interactive simulator in Explorer > KPI Framework > VVS tab. Uses external niche benchmark data.

kpis.name: Content Yield Index
kpis.description: Measures how efficiently the platform converts uploaded content into distributed, watched audience output. Multiplicative index across 5 pipeline parameters. 100 = all parameters at data-derived optimal.
kpis.formula: CYI = A * R_pub * L_in * L_out * P_view. A=amplification, R_pub=publish rate, L_in=input duration, L_out=output duration, P_view=view probability.

interpretation.key_insight: Multiplicative - every parameter compounds. Lifting R_pub from 0.74% to 8% multiplies CYI by ~10x.

kpis.note: Interactive simulator in Explorer > KPI Framework > CYI tab.

kpis.name: Platform Efficiency Score
kpis.description: How much watch-time you get per dollar relative to market average. Above 1.0 means buying cheaper than the norm.
kpis.formula: PES = Avg CPW (all platforms) / CPW (chosen platform & topic). Market avg CPW = $3.15.

output.description: Efficiency ratio. >1.0 cheaper, 1.0 at par, <1.0 premium

kpis.note: Interactive simulator in Explorer > KPI Framework > PES tab.

kpis.name: Geo Value Index
kpis.description: Scores each geographic region by reach per dollar vs market cost tier. Reveals where you get high volume and value.
kpis.formula: GVI = (Global avg CPW / Local CPW) * 100. 100 = global avg, >100 = above-avg reach, <100 = premium.

output.description: Geo value index. 100=global avg, higher=better value

kpis.note: Interactive simulator in Explorer > KPI Framework > GVI tab.
